name: winners-curse
title: Too good to be true at the top
idea: Units that reach the top by their estimates have estimates above their true values on average; a posterior mean whose prior matches the true values' center and spread takes back about all of it.
from: new angle · builds on v1 L-03's league; adds the top-k overshoot of estimates over true values, replay by replay, and its correction by the posterior mean
credit: Built for this site; the upward bias of the top estimates after Walters (2024, Handbook of Labor Economics), section 3.5, and Andrews, Kitagawa and McCloskey (2024).
caption: A simulated league built for this site: thirty fictional units with fixed true values; every replay adds noise of the unit's SE to each true value, computed in this browser. The posterior means come from a posterior set by hand for teaching; postrank does not fit it.
